name: codex-mcp-bridge
description: Connect ChatGPT to your own Codex Desktop projects and conversations.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your own Codex Desktop computer. Read saved projects and conversations, start an authorized task, or continue unfinished work. Requires Node.js 22+, Windows or macOS, signed-in Codex Desktop and Claude Desktop, the native relay, and a running outbound connector. Each account pairs its own computer and chooses allowed project roots. Interrupted sends are never automatically repeated.
